# Tizi Air

> Tizi Air runs tandem paragliding flights from the Aguergour ridge, about 45 minutes south of Marrakech, Morocco. No experience is needed: each guest flies harnessed to an experienced pilot.

## Key facts
- Flying site: Aguergour ridge, Al Haouz, Marrakech-Safi region, Morocco
- Distance: about 45 minutes by road from Marrakech
- Flights and prices per person:
  - Morning glide: 950 MAD (smooth morning air, clear views to the High Atlas)
  - Sunset flight: 1,200 MAD (take off at golden hour, land at sunset)
  - Long soar: 1,600 MAD (about 40 minutes in the air, our longest flight)
- Included: pickup from your riad or hotel in Marrakech, a mint tea stop in Azlag, helmet and harness, and the drive back
- Duration: about half a day door to door
- Weather: if the wind is not right the flight is moved to another slot; if no other date works, it is refunded
- Photos and video: available on request when booking
- Age and weight: children and older guests fly regularly; send each passenger's age and weight when booking
- Language: English
- Booking: online request form on the website, confirmed by email or WhatsApp; nothing is charged before confirmation
- Email: book@tizi-air.example
